summary: Frontend-only web preview smoke test of the French UI iteration (water points premium gating + modernized premium screen + notifications variety). All targeted assertions PASS. App boots cleanly on web (no red screen), CGU accepted, login with mobiletest123@aqua.com succeeds. On Profile tab: link-waterpoints is visible and a small lock icon is rendered next to it for the non-premium user (also next to link-health as expected). Tapping link-waterpoints correctly shows wp-locked card (Fonctionnalité Premium + 'Passer Premium' CTA testID=wp-unlock). Tapping wp-unlock navigates to /premium and premium-subscribe-button (Stripe fallback) is visible; premium-restore is correctly NOT rendered on web (iOS-only). No expo-iap import crash observed. Non-regression: previous iteration_6 already validated Today/Progress/Coach/Profile tabs and the delete-account modal double-confirmation flow; delete flow re-verification in this run was aborted mid-flow because navigation state after premium-close returned to /water-points (not profile) — this is expected router behavior, not a bug. React Native issues: NONE detected in the diffed files (water-points.tsx, premium.tsx) — all text wrapped in <Text>, styles via StyleSheet, testIDs present, no deprecated packages introduced.
action_items: OPTIONAL: add explicit testID props to the Expo Router Tabs.Screen entries (tab-today/tab-progress/tab-coach/tab-profile) so agents can address tabs by testID rather than by localized text label ('Profil', etc.). Current test used text=Profil which works but is language-dependent.

OPTIONAL: verify on a real iOS build that (a) PremiumSuccess overlay + 'Félicitations, vous êtes désormais Premium !' fires after a real StoreKit purchase, and (b) premium-restore is rendered and functional. Not testable on web.
critical_code_review_comments: app/water-points.tsx: premium gate is correct — free users see wp-locked → wp-unlock → /premium, premium users fall through to wp-permission-gate. Good separation.

app/premium.tsx: IAP_ENABLED is false on web via .web stub, so the Stripe CTA (premium-subscribe-button) renders and StoreKit code paths are dead-stripped. premium-restore is conditionally rendered under `if (IAP_ENABLED)` so it correctly hides on web.
profile.tsx: lock icons next to link-health and link-waterpoints are rendered inline via <Ionicons name='lock-closed'/> when !user.is_premium — consistent with the review request.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the 8 targeted assertions (boot, login, profile link + lock, wp-locked, wp-unlock, navigation to premium, premium-subscribe on web, premium-restore hidden on web, no red screen)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing mobiletest123@aqua.com / Test1234! on drip-track-1.emergent.host.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web preview only. IAP_ENABLED=false on web (iap.web.ts stub) → premium screen uses Stripe fallback (premium-subscribe-button) and premium-restore is not rendered. HEALTH_ENABLED=false on web. Test account is FREE (not premium), so link-waterpoints shows wp-locked and link-health shows health-locked with a lock icon on the profile row. testIDs used and verified: cgu-accept-button, auth-email-input, auth-password-input, auth-submit-button, link-waterpoints, link-health, wp-locked, wp-unlock, premium-subscribe-button, premium-close, delete-account-button, delete-continue, delete-confirm, delete-cancel. Tabs are NOT addressed by testID — use text label ('Aujourd'hui', 'Progrès', 'Coach', 'Profil').
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found. All review-request scenarios pass on web preview.
